scientific_integrity: The strict orbit comparison for 7 <= n <= 35 is checked by exhaustive exact-rational operations in included checker.py; for n >= 36 the proof is analytic. No independent mathematical audit or machine-formal proof has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only canonical Euclidean-orthogonal cut/cycle projections on real, unweighted squared-cycle edge spaces for integer n >= 7. No result for arbitrary minimal projections, other graph powers, weights or intermediate ell_p norms. The remainder in both asymptotics is O(1/n).
title: Exact endpoint Hodge norms and a logarithmic finite-size defect on squared cycles
